name: Alliance Movers
summary: Local and regional moving support for apartment and condo shifts — lift bookings, padding duties, and inventory discipline without full-container corporate freight.
body: For intra-island condo moves, local movers can be more proportionate than full international freight agents. Ask who pays the MCST damage deposit (often S$500–1,000), who installs lift padding, and whether trolley distance from loading bay to lift triggers a surcharge — Reddit condo threads treat these as standard variables, not surprises. Insist on a written inventory, insurance clarity, and weekday lift slots coordinated with both buildings’ managing agents. If any unaccompanied overseas boxes are in the mix, confirm Singapore Customs GST-relief steps separately; domestic movers may not handle Declaration of Facts. Photograph meter readings and existing damage on both ends so aircon brackets and flooring disputes do not become deposit fights.
